label: Iron Hills built-in imagegen preview intake
sourceNote: Preview-only sheets generated in Codex using the built-in image generation tool. They are copied here so visual QA and future slicing do not depend on transient generated_images filenames.

sheets.title: Armor helmets and headwear
sheets.intendedUse: Helmet/headwear candidate direction for light, medium, heavy, darkiron, and mithril armor sets.

sheets.title: Armor arms and hands
sheets.intendedUse: Bracer, vambrace, sleeve, and gauntlet direction for armor slot expansion.
notes: Needs individual cell slicing before use

sheets.title: Armor legs and feet
sheets.intendedUse: Boot, chausses, greaves, and sabaton direction for armor slot expansion.

sheets.title: Clothing and robes
sheets.intendedUse: Non-armor clothing direction for travel, scholar, noble, and arcane outfits.
notes: Useful for future clothing catalog or armor subtype expansion

sheets.title: NPC archetype portraits
sheets.intendedUse: Foundry NPC portrait direction for merchants, healers, guards, scholars, fences, and envoys.

sheets.title: Monster archetype portraits
sheets.intendedUse: Foundry monster/token portrait direction for early creature content.

sheets.title: Spell school identity icons
sheets.intendedUse: School-level identity direction for fire, ice, lightning, shadow, light, earth, mind, and summon.
notes: Good physical artifact language for schools
Can guide default school fallback art

sheets.title: Offensive spell icons
sheets.intendedUse: Single-target and focused attack direction for core spell catalog damage entries.

sheets.title: AoE geometry spell icons
sheets.intendedUse: Visual vocabulary for AoE shape/type mechanics: cone, circle, ray, rect, chain, nova, shards, aimed zones.
notes: Tactical readability is the main value of this sheet

sheets.title: Support and control spell icons
sheets.intendedUse: Support/control direction for healing, protection, haste, slow, fear, grapple, and gate lock mechanics.
notes: Some cells may need regeneration before final use because support effects can drift toward face-like silhouettes

sheets.title: Magical inventory items
sheets.intendedUse: Inventory/trader direction for scrolls, grimoires, wands, staves, foci, and catalysts.
notes: Good bridge between magic catalog and Tarkov-style trade inventory

sheets.title: High-tier destructive spell icons
sheets.intendedUse: Late-game destructive spell direction for elemental, shadow, and lifesteal spells.
notes: High-tier power reads well without becoming a full battlefield scene

sheets.title: High-tier utility and summon spell icons
sheets.intendedUse: Late-game utility/control/summon direction for divine, earth, mind, and summoning spells.
notes: Summon effects show gates and bindings instead of full creatures, which fits action-bar spell icons
